setName: Structure Deck: Fury from the Deep

Common.name: 7 Colored Fish
Common.desc: A rare rainbow fish that has never been caught by mortal man.

Common.name: A Legendary Ocean
Common.desc:
(This card's name is always treated as "Umi".)
All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.

Common.name: Amphibious Bugroth MK-3
Common.desc: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

Common.name: Big Wave Small Wave
Common.desc: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters you control, then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

Common.name: Call of the Haunted
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Common.name: Creature Swap
Common.desc: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

Common.name: Creeping Doom Manta
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

Common.name: Dust Tornado
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

Common.name: Fenrir
Common.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard. When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips their next Draw Phase.

Common.name: Gravity Bind
Common.desc: Level 4 or higher monsters cannot attack.

Common.name: Hammer Shot
Common.desc: Destroy 1 face-up Attack Position monster with the highest ATK. (If it is a tie, you get to choose.)

Common.name: Heavy Storm
Common.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

Common.name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
Common.desc: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; destroy all other cards on the field.

Common.name: Mermaid Knight
Common.desc: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

Common.name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
Common.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

Common.name: Mother Grizzly
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 WATER monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

Common.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Pot of Greed
Common.desc: Draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Premature Burial
Common.desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

Common.name: Reload
Common.desc: Add all cards in your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your Deck.

Common.name: Salvage
Common.desc: Target 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

Common.name: Sea Serpent Warrior of Darkness
Common.desc: A warrior who defends the world of the Sea of Darkness. He prides himself on his fighting prowess both on the ground and, of course, in the water.

Common.name: Snatch Steal
Common.desc: Equip only to a monster your opponent controls. Take control of the equipped monster. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: They gain 1000 Life Points.

Common.name: Space Mambo
Common.desc: A Space Mambo floating in the vast universe. This living relic was found in the ruins of a super civilization on Alphard 4.

Common.name: Spell Shield Type-8
Common.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● When a Spell Card is activated that targets exactly 1 monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
● When a Spell Card is activated: Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Common.name: Star Boy
Common.desc: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all WATER monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all FIRE monsters by 400 points.

Common.name: Tornado Wall
Common.desc: Activate only while "Umi" is on the field. While "Umi" is face-up on the field, you take no Battle Damage from attacking monsters. Destroy this card when "Umi" leaves the field.

Common.name: Torrential Tribute
Common.desc: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Common.name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
Common.desc: Discard 1 card from your hand and declare 1 Type of monster. Destroy all face-up monsters of the declared Type on the field.

Common.name: Unshaven Angler
Common.desc: When Tribute Summoning a WATER monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

Common.name: Xing Zhen Hu
Common.desc: Activate by selecting 2 Set Spell or Trap Cards on the field. The selected Spell or Trap Cards cannot be activated.

Ultra Rare.name: Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus
Ultra Rare.desc: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Levia-Dragon - Daedalus". You can send "Umi" you control to the Graveyard to send all cards in both players' hands and on the field to the Graveyard, except this card.
